title: Stats/Completion
wikitext:
You can see your completion points at the top of the stats page. Most permanent unlocks contribute 1 completion point each.

==Unlocks that add completion points==
===Prestige===
* Artifact Levels
===Workshop===
* Workshop Upgrades
===Drones===
* Drone Upgrades
* Drone Suit Unlocks
* Drone Suit Upgrades
* Drone Fuel Grades
* Drone Coal Upgrades
===Skill-Tree===
* Skill levels
===Challenges===
* Challenges Completed
===Store===
* Gem Unlocks
* Gem Upgrades
===Cards===
* Card Levels (+1 for Standard, +2 for Gilded, +3 for Polychrome, +4 for Infernal)
===Pets===
* Pet Levels
* Pet Skins
* Pet Quest Levels
===Construct===
* Statue levels (+1 for Standard, +2 for Gilded, +3 for Platinized)
* Vein Research
* Vein 2x Research
===Stargazing===
* Star Levels
* Star Upgrades
* Superstar Upgrades
* Blackhole Levels
===Archaeology===
* Idols Discovered
* Idol Quests Complete
===Fishing===
* Fish Upgrades
* Notice Rewards
* Legendary Fish Caught
* Legendary Fish Tributes
===World Quests===
* World 4 Quests
==Unlocks that do not add completion points==
===Cards===
* Founder bomb if you are not a founder
===Challenges===
* Challenge Rewards
===Archaeology===
* Ascensions
* Upgrades
* Idol levels
===Fishing===
* Enhance Upgrades
===This Prestige===
* Bar Upgrades
* Contracts
